product_desc: raw whole white prawns, shells translucent grey, heads and tails intact
cook: a professional chef in their thirties, dark chef coat with sleeves rolled to the forearm, quick and confident hands
kitchen: a Chinese-style professional kitchen, a gas wok range with a visible blue ring flame, dark stainless surfaces, warm overhead light
prep_subject: whole shell-on prawns being turned through a wide bowl of corn starch until every shell carries a thin even white dusting. Laid out on the steel counter beside the bowl, left to right: a small dish holding coarse sea salt, ground white pepper and whole red Sichuan peppercorns in separate heaps; sliced red chilli cut on the diagonal with the seeds showing; peeled whole garlic cloves; shredded ginger; and cut spring onion
prep_defines: the starch dusting on the shells, and the five things on the counter: the salt and pepper dish, sliced red chilli, whole garlic cloves, shredded ginger and cut spring onion
cook_vessel: a wok of hot frying oil
cook_subject: the prawns partway through frying in a wok of clear hot oil, the shells turning from translucent grey toward bright orange-red and beginning to blister and crisp, the bodies curling tight, oil moving fast around them. No aromatics are in the oil at this stage
cook_negatives: aromatics fried together with raw prawns, prawns simmered in sauce, soft pale shells, a wet glossy sauce, batter, breadcrumbs, peeled prawns
hero_subject: the finished prawns piled on a white platter, shells bright orange-red and visibly crisp and dry rather than saucy, crusted with coarse salt and white pepper and studded with blistered spring onion, gold garlic cloves, shredded ginger, red chilli and dark Sichuan peppercorns, a wedge of lemon at the edge
hero_setting: a dark wooden table, warm restaurant lighting, a small dish of lime beside
story: starch-dusted prawns lowered into hot oil
fried until the shells go orange and crisp, then lifted out to drain
tossed with bloomed aromatics and salt and pepper, then plated
negatives_global: aromatics fried together with raw prawns, a wet or glossy sauce, batter, breadcrumbs, peeled or deveined tail-off prawns, soft pale shells, steamed prawns
first_heat: The oil erupts around the prawns the moment they land, the starch dusting turning instantly to a pale crust and the shells beginning to colour at the edges.
transform: the shells turn from translucent grey through pink to bright orange-red, the starch dusting sets into a dry blistered crust and the bodies curl tight. A wire spider then slides under them and lifts the whole batch clear of the oil to drain, leaving the wok holding nothing but oil. No garlic, chilli or seasoning has been in the oil at any point.
lift: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame, tip most of the hot oil out of the wok so only a thin film is left, then tip in the spring onion, shredded ginger, whole garlic cloves, sliced red chilli and Sichuan peppercorns from the counter all at once, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. The aromatics hit the thin oil and burst into a hard fast sizzle, the peppercorns darkening, the garlic going gold at the edges and the spring onion blistering where it lands.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame and tip the drained prawns back into the wok among the spring onion, ginger, garlic, chilli and Sichuan peppercorns frying in the thin film of oil, toss the whole thing once so the aromatics catch on every shell, and withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right, takes one prawn by its tail, lifts it clear of the platter and holds it steady at the centre of frame, the coarse salt and pepper crust and the fried garlic clinging to a dry crisp shell.
sound_01: A professional Chinese kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, a ceramic bowl sliding on stainless steel. In the second shot, the dry rustle of prawns turning through corn starch and the tap of a bowl being knocked to shake off the excess. In the third shot, a gas burner at full roar, then a violent explosive burst as the prawns hit hot oil. No speech.
sound_02: A heavy rolling fry throughout, oil crackling hard and then settling to a finer, drier crackle as the crust sets. In the second shot, the metallic scrape of a wire spider under the prawns and oil running back into the wok in fine threads. In the third shot, oil pouring away, then a hard fast burst of sizzling as spring onion, ginger, garlic, chilli and Sichuan peppercorns hit the thin film left behind. No speech.
sound_03: A kitchen at full heat. In the first shot, garlic and chilli hitting a thin film of hot oil with a short sharp sizzle, then the dry rattle of prawns being tossed back in against dry metal. In the second shot, the fine dry patter of coarse salt landing. In the third shot, one prawn lifted from the platter with a small dry click of shell. No speech.
music: A sharp percussive bed: fast shakers and tight hand drums with short string stabs landing on the sear, energetic and precise.

beats.c1s1: <Subject 1> draws the bowl of starch-dusted prawns and the small dishes of seasoning toward them across the counter in one movement.
beats.c1s2: Both hands of <Subject 1> turn the prawns through the corn starch until every shell is evenly dusted and shake the excess off, then slide the bowl to the near edge beside the dish of salt and Sichuan pepper.
beats.c1s3: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the bowl, tip the starch-dusted prawns into the hot oil in one movement, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty.
beats.c3s2: The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame holding the small dish of dry-roasted salt and ground Sichuan pepper, scatters it once across the prawns in a single pass, and withdraws straight up out of frame. The seasoning lands dry on dry crisp shells and nothing on the platter is wet or glossy.

clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at wok height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The wok of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over its burner, which stays visible at the bottom of frame throughout, the oil moving fast around the prawns that went in during clip 01. Their shells are already colouring at the edges. No hand enters and nothing is added: the prawns fry alone in clear oil, with no garlic, chilli or seasoning anywhere in the wok. The oil settles from its first violent burst into a steady fine bubbling as the crust sets. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
vessel_start: holding clear frying oil brought up to temperature and shimmering, with no aromatics, no seasoning and no food of any kind in it yet
